positions.as_written: Read it on more than one plane, because an undisplaced line through it follows the plate and hides in the plane that contains it.
Use a fluid sensitive sequence, since marrow oedema either side of the plate is often the only sign.
Compare with the other side when the question is whether the plate is widened.
